d: Long, flowing honey-blonde hair with side-swept bangs and a smooth texture frames a face with a youthful, mature appearance and sharp, confident blue eyes. The build is slender with a prominent chest. The outfit consists of a white, long-sleeved military jacket with black trim, a large red rose ornament at the collar, and a short, dark navy-blue pleated skirt. Signature details include a grey military officer's cap perched on the head and heavy grey mechanical naval artillery gear attached to the hips and back.
